title: Use Seedance 2.0 Omni in multi-frame mode by supplying multiple images as base…
content: Use Seedance 2.0 Omni in multi-frame mode by supplying multiple images as base keyframes to guide the video generation.
tips: Use Seedance 2.0 Omni in multi-frame mode by supplying multiple images as base keyframes to guide the video generation.
